title.narrative: 13th Cycle of the Dubai International Award for Best Practices

description.narrative:
The Dubai international Award for Best Practices (DIASBP) established in 1995, seeks to recognize initiatives which have made outstanding achievements in informing and improving urban programmes and policies and to recognize distinguished achievements in the area of sustainable development. It also contributes to raising awareness among decision-makers to adopt proven solutions that address social, economic and environmental challenges related to sustainable urban development.
This Agreement provides a framework for collaboration between the Dubai Municipality and UN-Habitat identify the successful global harnessing and knowledge of best practices on the implementation of the New Urban Agenda and urban-related Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) through the 13th Cycle of the Dubai International Award for best practices to improve the living environment.
The 13th Cycle of the Dubai International Award will commence in 2024, ith a one-year project time for the (i) preparation of marketing materials and launch, (ii) collection and analysis of the best practices, (iii) selecting through a Technical Advisory Committee and Jury, and (iv) Award Ceremony.
The Dubai International Award aims to become the main platform of best practices for sustainable urban development globally. To maintain the momentum and global recognition, the 13th Cycle of the Award will resume its 2-year cycle from the 12th Cycle which was held in 2020.
With the goal to accelerate implementation of the New Urban Agenda and the urban-related Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), this project aims to:
1. Strengthen and maintain the momentum and global recognition of the DIASBP cycles by launching a 13th Cycle of the Dubai International Award for Best Practices to be awarded in 2023.
2. The project to become the main convener of best practices for sustainable urban development globally, and to be documented on the UN-Habitat Best Practices Database as part of the New Urban Agenda Platform.
The award is given in five categories namely: (i) Best Practices Award in Urban Regeneration and Public Spaces (ii) Best Practices Award in Constructing the Most Beautiful and Sustainable Buildings in the World. (iii) Best Practices Award in Sustaining Urban Food Systems (iv) Best Practices Award in Addressing Climate Change and Reducing Pollution (v) Best Practices in Urban Infrastructure Planning and Management
